title: Cassandra RuleHit Record
description: Validates a single JSONL record describing an expected RuleHit emitted by the rules-engine.

caseId.description: Identifier tying the record back to its goldset case.

type.description: Discriminator that should remain RuleHit for validation clarity.

severity.description: Rule severity string; accepted values align with rules-engine severity levels.

message.description: Optional human-readable summary for the rule hit.

evidence.description: Collected evidence such as snippets, table names, consistency level.
